purpose: Teach: 潮流/産み/就学/幕末/細川/秀吉/道筋/偽り

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、潮流に流された遺留品を、警察、回収されてますね
lines.en: So with this case—the evidence that's been swept along by the current, the police are recovering it, aren't they?
lines.style: Measured, slightly formal. Pause before the question tag. Building a logical chain, not rushing. Genuinely curious where this leads.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯人の産み出した状況証拠を分析します
lines.en: The police are analyzing the circumstantial evidence the suspect created.
lines.style: Steady, procedural tone. Each clause lands with quiet authority. Professional distance maintained. No inflection, just facts in order.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、就学児童への声かけ事案を、警察、注視されてますね
lines.en: And regarding the approach-to-children incidents in this case—the police are monitoring those closely, aren't they?
lines.style: Same careful pacing as before. Slight weight on 'closely'—this matters more. The question tag is gentle but pointed.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、幕末の刀剣盗難事件も扱います
lines.en: The police are also handling the sword theft cases from the Bakumatsu period.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact shift to a new subject. No strain. The addition of 'also' is breezily confident. Still procedural, still factual.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、細川家ゆかりの古文書盗難を、警察、扱われてますね
lines.en: And the theft of historical documents connected to the Hosokawa clan—the police are handling that as well, yes?
lines.style: Continuing the pattern but with slight recognition of the expanding scope. The question tag hints at mild surprise at the breadth.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、秀吉ゆかりの史跡破壊事件も把握します
lines.en: The police are also aware of the destruction of historical sites connected to Hideyoshi.
lines.style: Unruffled, still procedural. The scope keeps widening but Officer Takeda doesn't blink. Brief, confident.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、犯行の道筋を、警察、特定されてますね
lines.en: So as for this case—the path the crime took—the police have identified it, haven't they?
lines.style: Building toward something. The question is more purposeful now, less open-ended. Leaning slightly forward in thought.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の偽り供述を厳しく追及します
lines.en: The police will pursue the suspect's false statements with rigor.
lines.style: Shift to a harder edge. 'Rigor' lands with weight. Closer, more direct. The professional mask tightens slightly—this is the moment that matters.
